questions.q: All visitors must sign in at the front desk ------- entering the building.
questions.why: 「〜するとすぐに」の意味で動名詞を伴う upon が入る（upon entering）。onto・among は意味が合わず、during の後には名詞が来る。

questions.q: The replacement part will arrive ------- three to five business days.
questions.why: 期間を表す語の前で「〜以内に」を表すのは within。

questions.q: ------- the heavy rain, the outdoor concert went ahead as scheduled.
questions.why: 後ろが名詞句で「〜にもかかわらず」の意味になる Despite が入る。Unless は接続詞、However は副詞。

questions.q: Ms. Okafor has been responsible ------- the Lisbon account since 2022.
questions.why: be responsible for 〜「〜に責任がある」の決まった形。

questions.q: ------- the budget was approved late, the project team still met its deadline.
questions.why: 後ろが「主語＋動詞」で、譲歩を表す接続詞 Although が入る。Despite と Because of は前置詞。

questions.q: Please submit your expense report by Friday ------- you can be reimbursed this month.
questions.why: 「〜できるように」と目的を表す接続詞 so that が入る。in case of は前置詞で、後ろが節になっていない。

questions.q: The store will remain open late ------- the sale ends on Sunday.
questions.why: 後ろに節が続き「〜まで」を表す接続詞的用法の until が入る。during と within は前置詞。

questions.q: Even though applicants ------- the required certificate, they must also complete an interview.
questions.why: Even though の節の主語 applicants（複数）に対する現在形の動詞 have が入る。

questions.q: The newly hired accountant, ------- previous employer was a bank, will start on Monday.
questions.why: 空所の後ろの名詞 previous employer を修飾して「その〜」を表す所有格の関係代名詞 whose が入る。

questions.q: The new software, ------- was released in March, has received positive reviews.
questions.why: 先行詞 the new software（物）を受け、主語になる非制限用法の関係代名詞 which が入る。

questions.q: Ms. Tanaka asked the interns to introduce ------- to the staff.
questions.why: introduce の目的語が主語（interns）と同じ人たちなので再帰代名詞 themselves が入る。

questions.q: A list of the new regulations ------- posted on the bulletin board.
questions.why: 主語の中心は単数の list なので、単数に対応する has been が入る。

questions.q: Rarely ------- such a large number of applications in a single week.
questions.why: Rarely など否定の副詞が文頭に出ると倒置が起こり、助動詞＋主語＋過去分詞の語順になる。

questions.q: Not only ------- the new model cheaper, but it is also more durable.
questions.why: Not only が文頭に出ると倒置になる。be 動詞の文なので is が主語の前に出る。

questions.q: The committee made a ------- decision to postpone the vote.
questions.why: 名詞 decision を修飾する形容詞 cautious が入る。

questions.q: Mr. Dunn's presentation was ------- received by the board members.
questions.why: 過去分詞 received を修飾する副詞 warmly が入る。

questions.q: The ------- of the new payroll system will take about two months.
questions.why: 冠詞の後ろ、前置詞 of の前なので、名詞 implementation が入る。

questions.q: The restaurant is known for its ------- service and reasonable prices.
questions.why: 名詞 service を修飾する形容詞 exceptional が入る。

questions.q: Employees are required ------- their ID badges at all times.
questions.why: be required to do の形で、不定詞 to wear が入る。

questions.q: By the time the auditors arrive next week, we ------- all the records.
questions.why: By the time ＋未来の時点に対して、完了している内容は未来完了で表す。

questions.q: The company plans to ------- its product line to include eco-friendly items.
questions.why: 「製品ラインを広げる」の意味になる expand が自然。

questions.q: Please ------- the attached form and return it to Human Resources.
questions.why: 「書類に記入する」は complete a form。

questions.q: The new policy will take ------- on January 1.
questions.why: take effect で「発効する」。affect は動詞、effective は形容詞なので入らない。

questions.q: Due to a ------- in the supply chain, deliveries will be delayed.
questions.why: 配送の遅れの原因になる「混乱・中断」を表す disruption が入る。

questions.q: Ms. Reyes was ------- for her outstanding contribution to the sales team.
questions.why: 「功績を認められる・表彰される」の意味の recognized が入る。

questions.q: The contract is ------- to renewal after two years.
questions.why: be subject to 〜「〜の対象となる」の決まった形。

questions.q: Only ------- employees may enter the laboratory.
questions.why: 「許可された従業員」を表す過去分詞形の形容詞 authorized が入る。

questions.q: The hotel offers ------- rates for groups of ten or more.
questions.why: 団体向けの「割引料金」を表す discounted が入る。

questions.q: The audit revealed several ------- in the accounting records.
questions.why: 監査で見つかる「食い違い」の意味になる discrepancies が入る。

questions.q: We would appreciate it if you could ------- us of any changes to your schedule.
questions.why: notify 人 of 事「人に事を知らせる」の形をとるのは notify。
前半が原因、後半が結果の関係なので、結果を導く接続詞 so が入る。

c: Our showroom is open daily from 9 A.M. to 6 P.M.
The new delivery date will be confirmed by e-mail as soon as the frame arrives.
Your payment was returned to your account yesterday.
Several customers have praised the Ridgeline's comfortable seat.
questions.why: 遅れの説明の後に、新しい配送日の連絡方法を述べる文が自然につながる。他は文脈と無関係か、内容が矛盾する。
「注文を継続する場合は」という条件を表す If が入る。
a token of our apology で「おわびのしるし」。
助動詞 will の後ろなので動詞の原形 extend が入る。

c: Tickets for the planetarium show can be purchased online.
The museum will be closed for renovation throughout December.

questions.why: 「今回の延長」と「働く家族の声」の間に、これまでの閉館時刻を述べる文が入ると流れが通る。
名詞 hours を修飾する形容詞 additional が入る。
「展示が始まるまで」を表す接続詞 until が入る。during は前置詞で後ろに節を取れない。
be 動詞の後ろで受け身を作る過去分詞 permitted が入る（be permitted to do）。

c: Bookings made outside the portal will not be reimbursed.

questions.why: 直前の「直接予約は認められない」を受けて、ルール違反の場合の扱いを述べる文が自然。
先行詞 Employees が複数なので、関係詞節の動詞は複数形対応の expect が入る。
「ご質問については」を表す For any questions の形。
名詞 way を修飾する形容詞 convenient が入る。

Membership cards must be shown at the front desk.

questions.why: 新しいクラスの紹介の後に、クラスの特徴を補足する文が自然につながる。

docs.label: Article
docs.text:
Orlin Textile to Add 80 Jobs

DUNMORE (April 12) — Orlin Textile, a manufacturer of upholstery fabric, announced Monday that it will hire 80 additional workers at its Dunmore plant over the next year. The expansion follows a contract with Kestrel Furniture, which will purchase fabric from Orlin for its new line of office chairs.

"We were fortunate to win this contract," said plant manager Teresa Boyle. "It allows us to restore the second shift that we suspended two years ago." The company said that hiring will begin in June, and interested candidates should apply through the plant's Web site. Orlin currently employs 310 people in Dunmore.

Mayor Ravi Desai said the new jobs would be "a welcome boost for families in the region."

Ferry to Cut Winter Service

ISLE OF PENROSE (September 30) — Penrose Ferry Lines announced Tuesday that, beginning November 1, it will reduce weekday sailings between Penrose and Calder Harbor from eight to five per day. Company spokesperson Naomi Fenn said ridership drops by nearly 40 percent in winter, and the savings will help pay for a new vessel scheduled for delivery next year. Weekend schedules will not change. Fares will remain the same, but commuters who hold monthly passes will receive a 20 percent credit on their December pass. The island council will hold a public meeting on October 14 to discuss the decision.
